function.name: impl_from_IBindCtx
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a BindCtxImpl structure that contains the IBindCtx interface passed to it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IBindCtx interface

function.return_type: BindCtxImpl pointer, which represents the containing record of the IBindCtx interface

function.name: BindCtxImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches the ones implemented by the object. If it does, it assigns the interface to the output parameter and increases its reference count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface ID to be checked

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the output parameter that receives the interface pointer if the interface ID matches

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the interface ID matches, E_NOINTERFACE if it doesn't, and E_POINTER if the output parameter is NULL

function.name: BindCtxImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the BindCtxImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IBindCtx interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: BindCtxImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases the binding context, decrements the reference count, and if the reference count is zero, it releases bound objects and frees the memory allocated for the binding context and its table.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the interface of the binding context to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the reference count after decrementing.

function.name: BindCtxImpl_RegisterObjectBound
function.description: This function registers an object in the first free element in the table if the object is not null. If the last index equals the table size, it expands the table.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface used to access the BindCtxImpl

parameters.name: punk
parameters.description: Object to be registered

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, returns S_OK if the operation is successful

function.name: BindCtxImpl_RevokeObjectBound
function.description: This function revokes a previously bound object from the binding context. If the object is not found, it returns an error. It also shifts all elements in the right side of the current revoked object to the left.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the binding context from which the object is to be revoked.

parameters.name: punk
parameters.description: Pointer to the object to be revoked.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the punk parameter is NULL, and MK_E_NOTBOUND if the object was not previously registered.

function.name: BindCtxImpl_ReleaseBoundObjects
function.description: This function releases bound objects from the binding context implementation. It iterates over the binding context table, releasing any objects found and freeing the associated memory. The last index of the binding context table is then reset to 0.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the binding context.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. S_OK is returned if the operation is successful.

function.name: BindCtxImpl_SetBindOptions
function.description: This function sets the binding options for a given interface. It checks if the provided binding options are valid, and if so, it copies them into the interface's options.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface for which the binding options are to be set.

parameters.name: pbindopts
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the binding options to be set.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_POINTER if the provided binding options pointer is NULL, and E_INVALIDARG if the size of the provided binding options is invalid.

function.name: BindCtxImpl_GetBindOptions
function.description: This function gets the binding options of a BindCtxImpl object. It checks if the passed BIND_OPTS pointer is null, if so it returns an error. Otherwise, it copies the options from the BindCtxImpl object to the BIND_OPTS structure and sets the size of the structure.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the BindCtxImpl object.

parameters.name: pbindopts
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a BIND_OPTS structure where the options will be copied.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success and E_POINTER if the pbindopts pointer is null.

function.name: BindCtxImpl_GetRunningObjectTable
function.description: This function retrieves the running object table from the bind context implementation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the bind context implementation.

parameters.name: pprot
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the running object table.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. Returns E_POINTER if the pprot parameter is NULL.

function.name: BindCtxImpl_RegisterObjectParam
function.description: This function registers an object pointer under a given key in the bind context's string-keyed table of pointers.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the bind context.

parameters.name: pszkey
parameters.description: Pointer to the key under which the object is to be registered.

parameters.name: punk
parameters.description: Pointer to the object to be registered.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where S_OK represents successful execution and E_INVALIDARG or E_OUTOFMEMORY represent errors.

function.name: BindCtxImpl_GetObjectParam
function.description: This function retrieves an object from a bind context. It checks if the object exists in the bind context table and if it does, it increases the reference count of the object and returns a pointer to the object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: pszkey
parameters.description: Pointer to a string that represents the key of the object to retrieve from the bind context

parameters.name: punk
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IUnknown interface. This is where the function will store the pointer to the retrieved object

function.return_type: HRESULT. It returns S_OK if the function successfully retrieves the object, E_POINTER if the punk parameter is NULL, and E_FAIL if the object is not found in the bind context table

function.name: BindCtxImpl_RevokeObjectParam
function.description: This function revokes an object parameter from the binding context. If the object is found, it is released and removed from the table with a left-shifting of all objects on the right side.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the binding context

parameters.name: ppenum
parameters.description: Pointer to the object to be revoked

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_FAIL if the object is not found.

function.name: BindCtxImpl_EnumObjectParam
function.description: This function is not implemented, it sets the value of the pointer pszkey to NULL and returns E_NOTIMPL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: pszkey
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IEnumString interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating the function is not implemented.

function.name: BindCtxImpl_GetObjectIndex
function.description: This function searches for an object in the bind context table either by a register key or by a moniker. If the object is found, it sets the index to the object's location in the table and returns S_OK, otherwise it returns S_FALSE.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context implementation

parameters.name: punk
parameters.description: Pointer to the unknown object

parameters.name: pszkey
parameters.description: Pointer to the register key

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Pointer to the index of the object in the bind context table

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the object is found, S_FALSE otherwise

function.name: BindCtxImpl_ExpandTable
function.description: This function expands the size of the bind context table. If the table is not initialized, it allocates memory for the table. If the table is already initialized, it reallocates memory to double its size. If memory allocation fails, it returns an error.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the BindCtxImpl structure which contains the bind context table and its size.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: CreateBindCtx
function.description: This function creates a new bind context. It initializes the bind context with default values and returns a pointer to it.

parameters.name: reserved
parameters.description: This parameter should always be 0. If it is not, the function will return an error.

parameters.name: bind_context
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to an IBindCtx interface. The function will allocate memory for a new IBindCtx object, initialize it, and return the pointer to it via this parameter.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It represents the status of the operation. It will return S_OK if the operation was successful, E_INVALIDARG if the 'reserved' parameter is not 0 or 'bind_context' is NULL, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if the function could not allocate memory for the new IBindCtx object.

function.name: BindMoniker
function.description: This function binds a specified moniker to the object it identifies.

parameters.name: pmk
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface on the moniker to be bound to the object.

parameters.name: grfOpt
parameters.description: Controls aspects of the binding operation.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: The IID of the interface pointer desired.

parameters.name: ppvResult
parameters.description: Address of output variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an HRESULT error code.
